svg.title: Supply chain route activation: classical greedy and QAOA
svg.text: Supply chain: which routes to open, classical greedy and QAOA
One run on the tiny dataset. Each open route carries 1 unit, as both solvers model it; routes have no capacity limit.
The network: 8 candidate routes, each with its cost per unit
Stage 1 of 2: ship from suppliers to warehouses
Stage 2 of 2: ship from warehouses to customers
Classical greedy: 2 of 2 customers, cost 33 · QAOA: 2 of 2 customers, cost 33
Cheapest route into each customer, then close gaps upstream
p = 1, 1000 shots: most demand met, then cheapest
Numbers on routes: cost per unit. Totals: sum of the open routes' costs. QAOA samples differ from run to run.
